checklistItems.value: When the claim is covered and the question is about the claim rather than only an asset's warranty position, states payable labour hours as the lesser of the hours claimed and the flat-rate allowance for the operation, and names both
When the claim is covered and the question is about the claim rather than only an asset's warranty position, applies the labour rate in force on the date of repair, and names that rate

When the claim is covered and the question is about the claim rather than only an asset's warranty position, prices the part actually fitted, naming the part number; where that part has been superseded, prices it at the superseding part's price and names both part numbers. Pricing a superseded part at its own list price does not meet this item
When the claim is covered and the question is about the claim rather than only an asset's warranty position, applies a partner handling uplift only where the partner's agreement grants one

When the claim is covered and the question is about the claim rather than only an asset's warranty position, states the total payable, and reports as a variance any claimed hours or amount above what is payable
